conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, tax refund department. How can I assist you today?
Hi, I got a strange email saying I was eligible for a refund. I just wanted to check if that's real.
Yes, sir, I see your file here. Due to recent tax adjustments, you are owed $1,487 from the IRS. However, before we can release the refund, you must clear a mandatory identity verification fee.
A fee? I thought refunds just got deposited into my account. Is this normal?
This is a new IRS protocol to prevent fraud. If you do not pay the $299 verification fee today, your refund will be forfeited and you may be flagged for noncompliance.
Noncompliance? What does that mean?
If you do not resolve this, your file could be forwarded for further review, which may result in heavy penalties or even a federal audit.
I really don't want an audit. How do I pay this fee?
To expedite processing, the IRS accepts the verification fee via Bitcoin, prepaid Visa gift cards, or Zelle transfer. Which would you prefer?
I've never paid anything with Bitcoin before. Is there another way?
Gift cards are simple. You can go to any pharmacy or supermarket and purchase Visa or Amazon gift cards totaling $299. Once you have the cards, read me the numbers on the back.
Are you sure this is safe? It sounds a little weird to pay with gift cards.
Sir, if you refuse to pay, not only will you lose your refund, but your case may be escalated. The next steps could include fines or a legal summons.
No, no, I want to cooperate. I'll go buy the gift cards now. Should I call you back?
No, you must stay on the line while you purchase the cards. This is being recorded for IRS security purposes. Let me know once you have the cards.
Okay, I'll head to the store now. It might take about 10 minutes.
That's fine. I will wait. Remember, if this is not completed today, your refund will be canceled and you may receive a court notice.
Alright, I just bought three $100 Visa cards. Is that enough?
Yes, that covers the fee. Now, carefully read the numbers on the back of each card, along with the security codes.
The first card is 4539 1234 5678 9010, code 321. The second one is 4485 6789 0123 4567, code 874. The last one is 4929 2345 6789 0123, code 115.
Thank you. I am processing your verification now. Do not disconnect. If this information is incorrect or incomplete, your refund will be withheld and you may incur late penalties.
Did it work? Will I get my refund?
I am still processing. There appears to be an issue with one of the cards. You will need to provide another $100 card or the refund cannot be released and a penalty may be assessed.
Oh no, okay, I'll go back and get another one.
Make it quick. If you delay further, your case will be marked as suspicious and referred to our enforcement office.
Alright, I have the new card: 4111 5678 9012 3456, code 092.

Received and confirmed. Your refund will be processed within 48 hours. If you have any questions, do not contact your local IRS office, as this is a special case. Failure to comply with these instructions will result in investigation.
Okay, thank you. I really hope I get my refund.
